threadDescriptions.coding-drills: Practise scenario coding and maintain an error log for a fictional records-management certification.
threadDescriptions.mock-exam: Arrange and complete a timed mock of the records-management exam.
threadDescriptions.exam-reimbursement: Obtain employer reimbursement of certification fees.
threadDescriptions.kitchen-shelf: Install a kitchen shelf above the kettle.

items.text: Records certificate drills: fifteen retention scenarios each morning. Error log heading is 'Red list'; explain why I chose the wrong category.
Kitchen shelf bracket spacing 44 cm. Wall detector flags a cable on the right, so don't drill until the route is checked.
Ask training coordinator to reimburse the records certificate fee. Policy wants a paid receipt and manager's approval, even before the result.
Mock exam on Sunday: 80 questions, 100 minutes. Print one clean answer sheet and put the phone outside the room.
Library card expires this month. Renewal desk needs current address proof; electricity statement will do.
Retention drill: deletion freeze overrides the routine disposal date when a hold applies. My answer assumed the schedule kept running.
Manager approved exam expense. Finance rejected the bank screenshot; download the provider's itemized receipt.
Exam mock booklet erratum: this edition has 75 questions and a 90-minute allowance, replacing my 80/100 setup. Reprint the timer cover.
'Use current statement' torn corner, no logo.
items.rationale: Could refer to financial evidence or library address proof.

items.text: Shelf cable runs vertically from the socket. Move both brackets left by 8 cm; shelf still clears the kettle lid.
items.rationale: Updates shelf position to avoid cable.

items.text: Rename my 'Red list' study log to 'Reasoning repairs'. Same scenario errors; new heading reminds me to write the rule instead of just circling mistakes.
Library renewal accepted with electricity statement. New expiry date is next September; keep the same physical card.

Sunday mock finished in 88 minutes, 58 of 75 correct. Wrong answers cluster around legal holds and duplicate record copies. Don't judge progress from the raw score until the answer-key erratum is checked.
items.rationale: Records mock result and scoring caveat.

items.text: Mock review: after checking the erratum, score is 60/75. Copy the remaining hold and duplicate-copy errors into Reasoning repairs; schedule ten fresh scenarios in those categories for Tuesday, and annotate the mock answer sheet with the corrected key.
items.rationale: Corrects mock grading and sets targeted daily practice.

items.text: Finance received itemized exam receipt and manager approval. Reimbursement queued for next payroll under training, not travel.
Kitchen shelf installed level. Kettle lid clears by three fingers; let the adhesive screw covers settle before wiping.
Tuesday drills: nine out of ten holds/copies scenarios right. The miss was an active working copy, not a duplicate record.
Receipt? the one with the old number.
items.rationale: No source or purpose identifies the receipt.

items.text: Payroll line 'professional development' matches the full records exam fee. Mark reimbursement complete.
Keep the marked Sunday mock paper as the baseline. Next full mock will use a fresh booklet and the corrected 90-minute limit.
items.rationale: Preserves mock baseline and plans subsequent assessment.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: finance processing advances reimbursement, not preparation or scoring of the mock.
